findings.current: There was at least a ninety-percent chance that Tokyo International Airport, once the pride of Japan, had already been blown to absolute shit.

summary: The assembled English is broadly faithful, but it changes the broccoli image, rounds an approximate city count to ten, and omits the explicit warning that no safe runway landing is possible.
